function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

| **Rotten Tomatoes “New Releases” tab** | Shows new movies with critic & audience scores plus trailers. |
| **Letterboxd “Upcoming” feed** | Community‑curated lists of soon‑to‑be‑released films. |
| **Fandango / AMC / Regal sites** | Local theater listings and showtimes. |
| **Film festivals’ official pages** (e.g., Cannes, Toronto) | Preview of premieres before wide distribution. |
